mentions.author: Bucephalus355
mentions.why: Strikingly real HD footage of 1993 NYC.
mentions.quote: Apparently VHS came out with an HD format in the early 1990’s. Here’s a sample clip from 1993 of NYC: [VIDEO] It’s amazing. It so...looks like today, but it’s not. I don’t know how to describe the realness of image quality that looks like it was filmed earlier this afternoon…
